uncited_review.passage: Know, my brother, that faith has eight levels.
Indeed God is his master, and Gabriel, and the righteous of the believers.
The earth is inherited by My righteous servants.
Go to Muhammad. If he does not agree with you, then ask about his successor, and put to him proof.
Woe to you. By saying this you have added to your disbelief.
I bear witness that there is no god but God, that Muhammad is the Messenger of God, and that you are his guardian.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful, and the mercy and blessings of God.
A man from your flock and from the people of your country.
Have you committed any transgression in this land of mine since you entered it?
When war lays down its burdens, there is no harm in it.
Bring me al-Hasan, al-Husayn, and Muhammad.
O brother of the people of Syria, these are the sons of the Messenger of God (ع),
You have spoken truly, may God set you aright.
I bear witness that these are not from you, and that they come only from the mine of prophecy and the seat of the message. As for you, were you to ask me for a
O Abu al-Hasan, there are matters I neglected to ask the Messenger of God (ع) about. Do you have anything concerning them?
You have spoken truly, O Abu al-Hasan. May God not keep me alive after you, and may I never be in a land where you are not.
Their greeting on the day they meet Him is peace.
And they will be met therein with greeting and peace.
And the angels enter upon them from every gate: peace be upon you.
O you who believe, pray for him and submit to him in full submission.
When you enter houses, greet one another with a greeting from God, blessed and good.
And when you are greeted with a greeting, return it with something better, or return it as it is.

O God, bless the days and months, the hours of the day and the hours of the night, both the manifest and the hidden.
Let peace be proclaimed aloud, for that is better.
Say, I ask you no reward for it except affection toward my kin.
In the name of God. O God, اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ — make me among those who turn to You in repentance, and make me a
And if you are in a state of major impurity, then purify yourselves.
The earth has been made for me a place of prostration and a means of purification.
When a dog laps from the vessel of one of you, let him wash it seven times, one of them with earth.
Trimming the mustache is part of cleanliness, and it is of the Sunnah.
Do not pluck out the mustache, for it is a light for the Muslim.
Whoever grows a white hair upon his head while in Islam, it will be a light for him on the Day of Resurrection.
And let none of you sleep on the road, nor upon his face. Whoever you see sleeping upon his face, wake him.
Whomever the sea does not purify, may God not purify him.
It is not for a woman who has begun to menstruate to take up a qassa or a jumma.
When the woman is released from her ihram, she takes from the ends of the plaits of her head.
And who turns away from the creed of Ibrahim except one who has made a fool of himself?
The Messenger has no duty but clear delivery of the message.
Hasten the circumcision of your children, for it is purer for them.
The girl is not circumcised before she reaches seven years.
Whoever transgresses the limits has wronged himself.
Whatever the Messenger gives you, take it; and whatever he forbids you, abstain from it.
God admonishes you never to return to the like of it, if you are believers. God makes clear to you the signs, and God is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Let none of you toy with his beard during the prayer, nor with anything that distracts him from it.
Prayer is the offering of every godfearing person.
So woe to those who pray — those who are neglectful of their prayer.
Do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated.
There is nothing between the servant and disbelief except the abandonment of prayer.
There is no share in Islam for one who abandons prayer.

O you who believe, repent to God with a sincere repentance
When the evening meal is present, the evening prayer is set aside.
The morning prayer is attended by the angels of the night and the angels of the day.
Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High, who created and gave order.
Guard strictly the prayers and the middle prayer, and stand before God in devout obedience.
You asked about the imamate of the blind man. There is no harm in his leading if he is set straight, but he is not to be taken as a standing imam.
Indeed We sent it down on the Night of Decree
Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of God and His blessings; peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of God
Beware of wailing over the dead in a land where you hold authority.
O Messenger of Allah, you weep, yet you forbid us to weep?
Grieve with restraint, and hold fast to supplication.
O you who believe, fasting is prescribed for you as it was prescribed for those before you, so that you may be mindful of God, for a counted number of days; and
so whoever among you witnesses the month, let him fast it,
and that you complete the count and magnify God for having guided you.

They will not cease to differ, except those upon whom your Lord has mercy.
Have they not traveled through the land so that they might have hearts with which to understand, or ears with which to hear? For it is not the eyes that go blin
Do not be like those who separated and fell into disagreement.
If you dispute about anything, refer it to Allah and to the Messenger.
Had they referred it to the Messenger and to those charged with authority among them, those among them who draw out conclusions would have known it.
Fasting has been prescribed for you as it was prescribed for those before you, so that you may guard yourselves.
Shaban is my month, and Ramadan is the month of Allah, and fasting it is an obligation.
The fast of the month of Ramadan is an obligation upon every Muslim.
Of every thing We created two kinds, so that you might remember.
Have you not seen how your Lord extended the shadow?
He is the One who made the sun a radiance and the moon a light, and determined phases for it so that you might know the number of the years and the reckoning.
They ask you about the crescents. Say: they are appointed times for the people.
The number of the months with Allah is twelve months in the Book of Allah, from the day He created the heavens and the earth.
I am the most eloquent of the Arabs, and this is no boast

Compose for the meeting of so-and-so a poem that you may recite to him,
If it is obscured from you, then count thirty days
They were commanded only to worship Allah, sincere to Him in religion.
Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity.
If it is obscured from you, then count thirty days
We shall show them Our signs in the horizons and in their own souls, until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth.
I am the city of knowledge and Ali is its gate. Whoever desires knowledge, let him come to the gate.
The month of Ramadan, in which the Quran was sent down as guidance for the people, and as clear proofs of guidance and of the criterion.
Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet.
Whoever among you witnesses the month, let him fast it.
There is no marriage except with a guardian and two witnesses.
And whoever is sick or on a journey, then a number of other days.
The creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most people do not know.
We shall show them Our signs on the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth.
Blessed is He who placed constellations in the sky and placed in it a lamp and an illuminating moon.
So I swear by the settings of the stars, and it is indeed a great oath, if you only knew.
So I swear by the receding stars, that run their course and hide.
It is He who made the sun a radiance and the moon a light, and determined for it stages, that you might know the number of the years and the reckoning.
